ARC-001-WARD-001-v1.0.title: Wardley Map: Patent Management System Procurement Strategy

controlFields.Regulatory: UK Patent Rules 2007 mandate paper filing option; legal signatures required for some documents
controlFields.Skills Gap: IPO IT team lacks ML/AI expertise; limited Kubernetes experience; legacy COBOL knowledge concentrated in 3 staff near retirement
controlFields.Budget Constraints: £7M budget fixed; HMT requires business case approval for >10% variance; contingency only 15% (£1.05M)
controlFields.Security Clearance: All personnel need BPSS minimum; OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE access needs SC clearance; vendor staff clearance takes 3-6 months
controlFields.International Dependencies: WIPO ST.96 timeline; EPO OPS API changes; IP5 offices vary in API maturity
controlFields.GDS Service Assessment: Public beta requires GDS Service Assessment (16 criteria); failure blocks go-live
controlFields.Data Migration: 3M published patents; 500K unpublished applications; 40 years of examination history; data quality issues (duplicates, encoding errors)
controlFields.1. Define user needs: User needs at top of map (0.95 visibility): Patent Applicants, Examiners, Public Users
controlFields.2. Make things accessible: WCAG 2.2 AA mandatory; GOV.UK Design System (0.75) reused
controlFields.3. Be open and use open standards: WIPO ST.96 XML (0.45), EPO OPS REST (0.68), OpenAPI 3.0 for APIs
controlFields.5. Use cloud first: AWS GovCloud UK (0.95); 100% cloud deployment; no on-premise infrastructure
controlFields.6. Make things secure: OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE controls; Cyber Essentials Plus (MQ-5); ISO 27001 (MQ-6); STRIDE threat model
controlFields.7. Make privacy integral: GDPR compliance; Data Protection Officer oversight; privacy by design; UK data residency
controlFields.8. Share, reuse and collaborate: GOV.UK Pay (0.90), Notify (0.92), Design System (0.75), Verify (0.68) reused; £570K savings
controlFields.9. Integrate and adapt technology: API-first architecture; OpenAPI 3.0; WIPO ST.96 XML; EPO OPS REST; microservices on Kubernetes
controlFields.10. Make better use of data: Open data portal (3M published patents); patent analytics; ML training data (10M classifications)
controlFields.11. Define your purchasing strategy: **THIS WARDLEY MAP**: Build vs Buy analysis; G-Cloud 14 procurement; 62% buy/reuse, 38% build
controlFields.12. Meet the Digital Service Standard: GDS Service Assessment planned (Month 15); public beta; alpha with 10 users; GOV.UK Design System
controlFields.13. Use common technology platforms: GOV.UK platforms (Pay, Notify, Design System, Verify/One Login); GDS standards; government cloud (AWS GovCloud)
controlFields.1. Understand users and their needs: Patent Applicants (0.85), Patent Examiners (0.75), Public Users (0.65)
controlFields.2. Solve a whole problem for users: End-to-end patent journey: Filing (0.52) → Classification (0.35) → Examination (0.38) → Publication (0.58) → Renewal (0.55)
controlFields.3. Provide a joined up experience: API Gateway (0.82) integrates all services; GOV.UK Design System (0.75) for consistent UI
controlFields.4. Make the service simple to use: GOV.UK Design System (0.75); Public Portal (0.68); WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility
controlFields.5. Make sure everyone can use the servic: WCAG 2.2 AA compliance; manual accessibility testing; IAAP-certified specialists
controlFields.6. Have a multidisciplinary team: Evaluation team: Enterprise Architect, CISO, Product Owner, Accessibility Specialist, Domain Architect
controlFields.7. Use agile ways of working: Agile delivery methodology scored (10 points); sprints, retrospectives, continuous deployment
controlFields.8. Iterate and improve frequently: Alpha (Month 6), Private Beta (Month 12), Public Beta (Month 15), Live (Month 18)
controlFields.9. Create a secure service: Authentication (0.68), Authorization (0.62), Audit Logging (0.85), STRIDE threat model
controlFields.10. Define success metrics: BR-001 (18→12 months), BR-002 (£2M savings), BR-003 (95% satisfaction), BR-004 (99.5% uptime)
controlFields.11. Choose the right tools and technolog: **THIS WARDLEY MAP**: Evolution-based tool selection; buy products, reuse GOV.UK services, build custom only when necessary
controlFields.12. Make new source code open: Open-source by default; IPO GitHub organization; MIT/Apache 2.0 licenses
controlFields.13. Use common platforms: GOV.UK Pay (0.90), Notify (0.92), Design System (0.75), Verify/One Login (0.68)
controlFields.14. Operate a reliable service: Monitoring (0.88), Audit Logging (0.85), Multi-AZ AWS (0.95), RTO 4h, RPO 1h
controlFields.15. Support a culture of learning: Alpha/beta feedback loops; retrospectives; blameless post-mortems
controlFields.16. Make your service supportable: Documentation, runbooks, training materials for IPO operations team
controlFields.17. Explain what data is collected: Privacy policy, DPIA, Data Protection Officer oversight, GDPR compliance
controlFields.18. Make your service work with any devi: Responsive design (GOV.UK Design System); mobile-first; supports assistive technologies
controlFields.Genesis (0.00-0.25): DO NOT PROCURE via G-Cloud; build in-house R&D; no vendors available
controlFields.Custom (0.25-0.50): BUILD in-house; no suitable G-Cloud vendors; IPO-specific requirements
controlFields.Product (0.50-0.75): BUY via G-Cloud 14 Direct Award (<£100K per service) or Further Competition (>£100K); multiple vendors available
controlFields.Commodity (0.75-1.00): USE AWS GovCloud UK (pre-approved); reuse GOV.UK services (free); commodity procurement
controlFields.WIPO Integration for International Filin: Application Intake (0.42), Patent Classification (0.35), Publication Engine (0.58)
controlFields.GOV.UK Services Bundle: GOV.UK Pay (0.90), GOV.UK Notify (0.92), GOV.UK Design System (0.75), GOV.UK Verify (0.68)
controlFields.AWS Managed Services Bundle: EKS (0.95), RDS (0.92), ElastiCache (0.90), OpenSearch (0.85), S3 (0.95), CloudFront (0.95), CloudWatch (0.88)
controlFields.Patent ML/AI Bundle: ML Classification Model (0.35), Semantic Search Engine (0.42), Patent Classification (0.35), Prior Art Search (0.42)
controlFields.International Integration Bundle: WIPO Integration (0.45), EPO Integration (0.68), IP5 Data Exchange (0.52)
controlFields.Security & Compliance Bundle: Authentication (0.68), Authorization (0.62), Audit Logging (0.85), STRIDE threat model
controlFields.Build World-Class Patent ML: ML Classification (0.35 Custom) gives IPO competitive advantage over other patent offices; USPTO/EPO have <90% accuracy; IPO targets 95%
controlFields.Open-Source Patent Tools: WIPO Integration (0.45), Semantic Search (0.42) built custom; open-source on GitHub to accelerate evolution to Product stage (0.65+); other patent offices adopt IPO code
controlFields.GOV.UK Patent Platform: IPO creates reusable "patent platform" (classification + search + workflow) for other UK IP rights (trademarks, designs); leverages Custom components (0.35-0.42)
controlFields.Patent API Marketplace: Public API (0.82 Product) monetized via premium tiers (bulk data, real-time updates); create developer ecosystem; £200K/year revenue
controlFields.Avoid Vendor Lock-In: BUY components (0.50-0.75) have lock-in risk; use open APIs, avoid proprietary formats; multi-cloud strategy (Terraform)
controlFields.Containerize All Apps: Kubernetes (0.95 Commodity) enables portability; avoid AWS-specific services where possible (Lambda, DynamoDB); use PostgreSQL (0.92) not Aurora
controlFields.Dual GOV.UK Services: GOV.UK Pay (0.90) and Notify (0.92) are free but have SLA risk; implement failover to commercial alternatives (Stripe, Twilio)
controlFields.Legacy PMS Decommissioning: Legacy Integration (0.35 Custom) is technical debt; plan decommissioning by 2027 to avoid ongoing maintenance (£200K/year)
controlFields.ML Model Bias Audits: ML Classification (0.35) may have bias (gender, race in inventor names; country of origin); legal risk if biased classifications delay certain applications
controlFields.Patent API Developer Portal: Public API (0.82 Product) creates developer ecosystem; encourage UK startups to build patent analytics, IP management tools
controlFields.ML Model Marketplace: IPO-trained ML models (Classification 0.35, Semantic Search 0.42) licensed to other patent offices, law firms, IP consultancies
controlFields.WIPO ST.96 Reference Implementation: IPO open-sources WIPO Integration (0.45) as reference implementation; other patent offices adopt; IPO influences WIPO standard evolution
controlFields.TR-001: Legacy PMS integration fails; 40-year-old system has undocumented interfaces, batch-only, COBOL codebase
controlFields.TR-002: ML classification accuracy <95%; model doesn't understand patent language nuances, technical terminology
controlFields.TR-003: WIPO ST.96 integration delays; WIPO standard evolving, IPO-to-WIPO mappings complex, international coordination slow
controlFields.TR-004: Semantic search doesn't understand patent claims; search results irrelevant; examiners lose trust; revert to keyword search
controlFields.TR-005: AWS GovCloud UK outage; eu-west-2 region failure; patent services unavailable for >4 hours (breaches NFR-001 RTO)
controlFields.TR-006: Chemical structure search (PerkinElmer ChemDraw) doesn't integrate with patent database; proprietary formats
controlFields.TR-007: OCR accuracy <98%; handwritten patent applications, poor scan quality, chemical formulas unrecognized
controlFields.SR-001: ML classification (0.35 Custom) commoditized by vendors (Clarivate, PatSnap) within 3 years; IPO £980K investment obsolete
controlFields.SR-002: Semantic search (0.42 Custom) becomes Product stage (0.65); Google Patents, Microsoft Academic provide free patent semantic search
controlFields.SR-003: GOV.UK Verify (0.68) decommissioned by GDS; replaced by GOV.UK One Login; IPO must migrate authentication
controlFields.SR-004: G-Cloud 14 vendors increase prices post-contract (lock-in); OCR, chemical search licensing costs double
controlFields.SR-005: UK Government budget cuts; IPO £7M project reduced to £5M; scope cut required; technical debt incurred
controlFields.SR-006: Patent examination automation (AI) eliminates examiner jobs; industrial action; project blocked by unions
controlFields.PR-001: Vendor proposals don't meet mandatory qualifications (MQ-1 to MQ-28); <3 qualified vendors; insufficient competition
controlFields.PR-002: Vendor fails security clearance (BPSS, SC); cannot access OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE patent data; project delayed 3-6 months
controlFields.PR-003: Vendor goes bankrupt mid-project; code/IP lost; re-procurement required; 6-month delay
controlFields.PR-004: Procurement timeline overruns; G-Cloud 14 call-off takes 6 months instead of 2 months; vendor onboarding delayed
controlFields.PR-005: Vendor proposal costs exceed £7M budget; lowest bidder is £9M; budget overrun or scope cut required
controlFields.BR-001: Reduce patent examination time from 18 to 12 months (33% improvement)
controlFields.BR-002: Achieve £2M annual cost savings through cloud modernization and automation
controlFields.BR-004: 99.5% system uptime (3M published patents, 50K applications/year, public access)
controlFields.BR-005: Open data: Publish 3M patents via public API (non-OFFICIAL data only)
controlFields.BR-006: International integration: WIPO (PCT), EPO (patent data exchange), IP5 (bilateral data sharing)
controlFields.FR-001: Patent application intake: digital forms, PDF upload, fee payment, filing date determination
controlFields.FR-002: Automatic patent classification using ML (CPC/IPC codes; 10,000 classes; 95% accuracy target)
controlFields.FR-003: Semantic prior art search across 3M published patents (keyword, classification, semantic similarity)
controlFields.FR-004: Examiner workflow: assign applications, conduct prior art search, write examination reports, issue objections, approve/reject
controlFields.FR-005: Patent publication: generate PDF/HTML, publish to public portal, notify applicants, export to WIPO/EPO
controlFields.FR-006: Renewal management: calculate renewal fees, send reminders, process payments, update patent status
controlFields.FR-007: Chemical structure search for pharmaceutical/chemistry patents (substructure, similarity search)
controlFields.FR-008: Public patent search: keyword, classification, applicant, inventor, filing date; results ranked by relevance
controlFields.FR-009: API for patent data: RESTful API, OpenAPI 3.0, rate limiting, authentication, bulk data download
controlFields.FR-010: Legacy PMS integration: batch data sync, bi-directional updates, data migration, parallel running (6 months)
controlFields.NFR-001: Performance: <3s page load, <500ms API response, 99.5% uptime, 4h RTO, 1h RPO
controlFields.NFR-002: Security: OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE controls, Cyber Essentials Plus, ISO 27001, STRIDE threat model, ITHC penetration testing
controlFields.NFR-003: Accessibility: WCAG 2.2 Level AA compliance, manual testing, IAAP-certified specialists, GOV.UK Design System
controlFields.NFR-004: Scalability: Support 50K applications/year, 200 concurrent examiners, 10K concurrent public users, 3M published patents
controlFields.NFR-005: Data Sovereignty: All data stored in UK (AWS eu-west-2 London region); GDPR compliance; DPO oversight
controlFields.NFR-006: Observability: Metrics (Prometheus), Logs (ELK/CloudWatch), Traces (OpenTelemetry), Dashboards (Grafana), Alerts
controlFields.Start Legacy PMS Integration: Legacy Integration (0.35 Custom) is critical path blocker; 6-month integration window required
controlFields.Deploy AWS Infrastructure (IaC): AWS (0.95 Commodity) is foundation for all services; Terraform IaC (0.80 Product) enables infrastructure-as-code
controlFields.Integrate GOV.UK Pay & Notify: GOV.UK services (0.90-0.92 Commodity) are free, mature; low integration effort (2 weeks each); £350K savings vs custom build
controlFields.Implement Authentication (Auth0): Authentication (0.68 Product) is dependency for all user-facing services; security critical (OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE); 4-week integration
controlFields.Start ML Model Training: ML Classification (0.35 Custom) requires 6-month training; must complete by Month 6 for alpha launch; train in parallel with service development
controlFields.Procure OCR Engine (ABBYY): OCR (0.72 Product) required for application intake (C-006); G-Cloud 14 Direct Award (<£100K); 98% accuracy requirement
controlFields.Engage WIPO Liaison Officer: WIPO Integration (0.45 Custom) has international dependencies; ST.96 XML coordination required; mitigate TR-003 risk
controlFields.Launch Alpha (10 examiners): GDS Service Standard requires alpha phase; validate ML classification (0.35), semantic search (0.42), examination workflow (0.38) with real users
controlFields.Complete WIPO ST.96 Integration: WIPO Integration (0.45 Custom) unblocks PCT applications (30% of intake); BR-006 international integration requirement
controlFields.Procure Chemical Structure Search: Chemical Structure Search (0.68 Product) required for pharmaceutical/chemistry patents; G-Cloud 14 Further Competition (>£100K); evaluate PerkinElmer vs InfoChem
controlFields.Integrate EPO OPS API: EPO Integration (0.68 Product) required for European patent data exchange; commercial wrapper (Darts-ip) reduces development effort
controlFields.Launch Private Beta (50 examiners): GDS Service Standard requires private beta; scale from alpha (10 users) to beta (50 users); validate performance (NFR-001) and security (NFR-002) at scale
controlFields.Launch Public Beta + GDS Assessment: GDS Service Standard Point 12 requires GDS Service Assessment before live; public beta with real users; GOV.UK Design System (0.75) de-risks assessment
controlFields.Live Launch + Legacy Decommissioning: New PMS replaces legacy system; legacy integration (0.35 Custom) decommissioned by 2027 to avoid £200K/year maintenance; parallel running ends
controlFields.Evaluate ML Commoditization (2028): ML Classification (0.35 Custom) may be commoditized by commercial vendors (Clarivate, PatSnap) by 2028; monitor SR-001 risk; plan migration to product
controlFields.Migrate to GOV.UK One Login: GOV.UK Verify (0.68) replaced by GOV.UK One Login (0.85 Commodity) by 2026; GDS mandates migration; £50K integration cost
controlFields.Open-Source Patent Tools (GitHub): WIPO Integration (0.45), Semantic Search (0.42) open-sourced to accelerate evolution to Product stage (0.65+); TCoP Point 4 (Open Source) compliance
